name: Glass Icon Showcase
description: A two-column icon-pack showcase: a left column with a brand mark, pill badge, big two-line heading, and community chip, and a right 4x4 grid of glassmorphic tiles, each a white rounded tile holding a token-gradient glyph with a glass highlight.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the copy fades up (wpmn-gis-up 600ms) and the 16 tiles pop in on a diagonal stagger (wpmn-gis-pop 550ms)
tiles lift and deepen their shadow on hover (200ms)
each glyph is filled with a per-tile token gradient plus an invert highlight for the glass look
prefers-reduced-motion: copy and tiles rendered in place, no animation or hover transition
